<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Whack 'Em All - 두더지 대소동</title>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Jua&display=swap');

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      background: transparent;
      font-family: 'Jua', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    }

    #arcade-cabinet {
      width: 580px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5dade2 0%, #82e0aa 48%, #52be80 62%, #2e7d32 100%);
      border-radius: 30px;
      padding: 18px 22px 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      border: 4px solid #1e5623;
    }

    /* 커스텀 마우스 망치 커서 (동적 클래스 부여) */
    .cursor-wood {
      cursor: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='50' height='50' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(-25 25 25)'><rect x='22' y='18' width='6' height='26' rx='2' fill='%23a0522d'/><rect x='10' y='8' width='30' height='15' rx='4' fill='%23cd853f' stroke='%238b4513' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='14' cy='15' r='2' fill='%235c2e0b'/></g></svg>") 12 12, auto !important;
    }
    .cursor-wood:active {
      cursor: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='50' height='50' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(-65 25 25)'><rect x='22' y='18' width='6' height='26' rx='2' fill='%23a0522d'/><rect x='10' y='8' width='30' height='15' rx='4' fill='%23cd853f' stroke='%238b4513' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='14' cy='15' r='2' fill='%235c2e0b'/></g></svg>") 12 12, auto !important;
    }

    .cursor-iron {
      cursor: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='50' height='50' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(-25 25 25)'><rect x='22' y='18' width='6' height='26' rx='2' fill='%232c3e50'/><rect x='8' y='7' width='34' height='16' rx='3' fill='%2395a5a6' stroke='%2334495e' stroke-width='2.5'/><line x1='14' y1='7' x2='14' y2='23' stroke='%237f8c8d' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='36' y1='7' x2='36' y2='23' stroke='%237f8c8d' stroke-width='2'/></g></svg>") 12 12, auto !important;
    }
    .cursor-iron:active {
      cursor: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='50' height='50' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(-65 25 25)'><rect x='22' y='18' width='6' height='26' rx='2' fill='%232c3e50'/><rect x='8' y='7' width='34' height='16' rx='3' fill='%2395a5a6' stroke='%2334495e' stroke-width='2.5'/><line x1='14' y1='7' x2='14' y2='23' stroke='%237f8c8d' stroke-width='2'/></g></svg>") 12 12, auto !important;
    }

    .cursor-golden {
      cursor: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='50' height='50' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(-25 25 25)'><rect x='22' y='18' width='6' height='26' rx='2' fill='%23c0392b'/><rect x='7' y='6' width='36' height='18' rx='4' fill='%23f1c40f' stroke='%23b7950b' stroke-width='2.5'/><polygon points='25,8 28,14 34,15 30,19 31,25 25,22 19,25 20,19 16,15 22,14' fill='%23ffffff' opacity='0.8'/></g></svg>") 12 12, auto !important;
    }
    .cursor-golden:active {
      cursor: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='50' height='50' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(-65 25 25)'><rect x='22' y='18' width='6' height='26' rx='2' fill='%23c0392b'/><rect x='7' y='6' width='36' height='18' rx='4' fill='%23f1c40f' stroke='%23b7950b' stroke-width='2.5'/></g></svg>") 12 12, auto !important;
    }

    /* 타이틀 */
    .title-banner {
      margin: 0 0 10px 0;
      font-size: 32px;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1b4317, -1px -1px 0 #1b4317, 1px -1px 0 #1b4317, -1px 1px 0 #1b4317;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* 망치 선택 바 */
    .weapon-select-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      border-radius: 50px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }

    .hammer-tab {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 25px;
      background: #fdfefe;
      border: 2px solid #bdc3c7;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #2c3e50;
      font-weight: bold;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .hammer-tab:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }

    .hammer-tab.selected {
      border-color: #e67e22;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffeaa7 0%, #fdcb6e 100%);
      color: #d35400;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(211, 84, 0, 0.35);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    /* 대시보드 */
    .dashboard {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-around;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      border: 2px solid #d5dbdb;
    }

    .stat-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #7f8c8d;
    }

    .stat-val {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .val-time { color: #e74c3c; }
    .val-score { color: #27ae60; }
    .val-high { color: #e67e22; }
    .val-combo { color: #8e44ad; }

    /* 3x3 격자 및 실제 파인 입체 구멍 구현 */
    .grid-container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    /* 움푹 패인 3D 구멍 */
    .crater-pit {
      position: relative;
      height: 122px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #1e1108 0%, #3a1e0b 60%, #4a270f 100%);
      border-radius: 50% / 35%;
      box-shadow: 
        inset 0 16px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.9),
        inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.08),
        0 8px 0 #204713,
        0 12px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 4px solid #5a3416;
    }

    /* 구멍 겉면 튀어나온 흙더미/잔디 림 (앞가림막) */
    .crater-pit::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -2px;
      left: -4px;
      right: -4px;
      height: 44px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 90%, #6d3d19 0%, #532c10 70%, #3e1f0a 100%);
      border-radius: 0 0 50% 50% / 0 0 45% 45%;
      border-bottom: 5px solid #285e13;
      box-shadow: inset 0 3px 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      z-index: 10;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* 구멍 주위 파인 흙 잔디 효과 테두리 */
    .crater-pit::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -2px;
      left: 10%;
      right: 10%;
      height: 8px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(2px);
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* 스폰되는 캐릭터/폭탄 래퍼 */
    .entity-box {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 10px;
      transform: translate(-50%, 125%);
      width: 86px;
      height: 96px;
      transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28);
      z-index: 5;
    }

    .entity-box.peek {
      transform: translate(-50%, 0%);
    }

    /* 타격 이펙트 및 폭발 이펙트 */
    .pop-score {
      position: absolute;
      top: 6px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #f1c40f;
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000, -1px -1px 0 #000;
      z-index: 30;
      animation: floatUp 0.6s ease-out forwards;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .pop-bomb {
      color: #e74c3c !important;
    }

    @keyframes floatUp {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 15px) scale(0.6); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -15px) scale(1.3); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -40px) scale(1); }
    }

    /* 폭탄 터짐 화면 쉐이크 */
    .screen-shake {
      animation: shake 0.35s ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes shake {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(-8px, 6px); }
      40% { transform: translate(8px, -6px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-6px, -4px); }
      80% { transform: translate(6px, 4px); }
    }

    /* 시작 버튼 */
    .play-btn {
      font-family: inherit;
      padding: 12px 38px;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: white;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff7675 0%, #d63031 100%);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #962020, 0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.1s ease;
    }

    .play-btn:hover {
      filter: brightness(1.08);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #962020, 0 14px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }

    .play-btn:active {
      transform: translateY(4px);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #962020, 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }

    /* 모달 오버레이 */
    .game-modal {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78);
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-radius: 26px;
      z-index: 50;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .modal-body {
      background: white;
      padding: 28px 40px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      text-align: center;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="arcade-cabinet" class="cursor-wood">
    <h1 class="title-banner">🔨 Whack 'Em All! 두더지 대소동</h1>

    <!-- 망치 무기 선택 탭 -->
    <div class="weapon-select-bar">
      <div class="hammer-tab selected" data-hammer="wood" onclick="selectHammer('wood')">
        <span>🪵 기본 나무망치</span>
        <small style="opacity: 0.8;">(1배)</small>
      </div>
      <div class="hammer-tab" data-hammer="iron" onclick="selectHammer('iron')">
        <span>⛓️ 강철 망치</span>
        <small style="opacity: 0.8;">(1.5배)</small>
      </div>
      <div class="hammer-tab" data-hammer="golden" onclick="selectHammer('golden')">
        <span>✨ 황금 해머</span>
        <small style="opacity: 0.8;">(2배)</small>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 스코어보드 -->
    <div class="dashboard">
      <div class="stat-col">
        <span class="stat-label">⏳ 남은 시간</span>
        <span id="txt-time" class="stat-val val-time">30초</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-col">
        <span class="stat-label">🎯 현재 점수</span>
        <span id="txt-score" class="stat-val val-score">0점</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-col">
        <span class="stat-label">🏆 최고 기록</span>
        <span id="txt-high" class="stat-val val-high">0점</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-col">
        <span class="stat-label">🔥 콤보</span>
        <span id="txt-combo" class="stat-val val-combo">0</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 3x3 움푹 파인 구멍 필드 -->
    <div class="grid-container" id="grid">
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-0"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-1"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-2"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-3"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-4"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-5"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-6"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-7"></div></div>
      <div class="crater-pit"><div class="entity-box" id="slot-8"></div></div>
    </div>

    <button id="btn-start" class="play-btn" onclick="startGame()">🚀 게임 시작!</button>

    <div id="modal-over" class="game-modal">
      <div class="modal-body">
        <h2 style="margin: 0 0 10px 0; color: #2c3e50; font-size: 30px;">🏁 게임 종료!</h2>
        <p id="txt-result" style="font-size: 22px; color: #e67e22; margin: 0 0 20px 0;">점수: 0점</p>
        <button class="play-btn" onclick="retryGame()">🔄 다시 도전하기</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // 1. 일반 두더지 SVG
    const SVG_MOLE_NORMAL = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 110" width="100%" height="100%">
      <path d="M15 105 C15 42, 24 20, 50 20 C76 20, 85 42, 85 105 Z" fill="#7a4422"/>
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="35" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#5c2e0e"/>
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="35" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffb4a2"/>
      <ellipse cx="80" cy="35" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#5c2e0e"/>
      <ellipse cx="80" cy="35" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffb4a2"/>
      <!-- 안전모 -->
      <path d="M22 28 C22 10, 78 10, 78 28 Z" fill="#f1c40f"/>
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="28" rx="31" ry="5.5" fill="#d4ac0d"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="7" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="3.5" fill="#f39c12"/>
      <!-- 볼 & 주둥이 -->
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#e8c29b"/>
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#e74c3c"/>
      <ellipse cx="48" cy="53" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <!-- 눈 -->
      <ellipse cx="37" cy="46" rx="4" ry="5.5" fill="#2c3e50"/>
      <circle cx="35" cy="44" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <ellipse cx="63" cy="46" rx="4" ry="5.5" fill="#2c3e50"/>
      <circle cx="61" cy="44" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <!-- 수염 & 앞니 -->
      <path d="M24 58 L11 55 M24 64 L12 66 M76 58 L89 55 M76 64 L88 66" stroke="#4a2e12" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="46" y="65" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <rect x="50" y="65" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <!-- 양손 발톱 -->
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="92" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#e8c29b"/>
      <ellipse cx="80" cy="92" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#e8c29b"/>
    </svg>
    `;

    // 2. 맞은 두더지 SVG
    const SVG_MOLE_HIT = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 110" width="100%" height="100%">
      <path d="M15 105 C15 42, 24 20, 50 20 C76 20, 85 42, 85 105 Z" fill="#6d3918"/>
      <!-- 찌그러진 헬멧 & 혹 -->
      <path d="M22 30 C22 12, 78 12, 78 30 Z" fill="#d4ac0d" transform="rotate(-9 50 30)"/>
      <ellipse cx="70" cy="18" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#e74c3c"/>
      <path d="M63 18 L77 18 M70 11 L70 25" stroke="#f1c40f" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- 주둥이 -->
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#d9b189"/>
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#c0392b"/>
      <!-- 뱅글뱅글 X 눈 -->
      <path d="M33 42 L41 50 M41 42 L33 50" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M59 42 L67 50 M67 42 L59 50" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#922b21"/>
      <!-- 항복 손 -->
      <ellipse cx="16" cy="84" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#d9b189" transform="rotate(35 16 84)"/>
      <ellipse cx="84" cy="84" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#d9b189" transform="rotate(-35 84 84)"/>
    </svg>
    `;

    // 3. 다이너마이트 / 폭탄 SVG (심지에 스파크)
    const SVG_BOMB = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 110" width="100%" height="100%">
      <!-- 심지 -->
      <path d="M50 35 Q50 18 68 14" fill="none" stroke="#d35400" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- 스파크 불꽃 -->
      <polygon points="68,14 74,8 72,14 78,13 74,18 80,21 73,22 75,27 69,22 65,26 67,19 62,18" fill="#f39c12"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="16" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <!-- 폭탄 구체 -->
      <circle cx="50" cy="68" r="34" fill="#2c3e50" stroke="#1a252f" stroke-width="3"/>
      <ellipse cx="38" cy="56" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#7f8c8d" opacity="0.6" transform="rotate(-25 38 56)"/>
      <!-- 폭탄 목 캡 -->
      <rect x="42" y="32" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#7f8c8d" stroke="#34495e" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- 해골/위험 마크 -->
      <text x="50" y="78" font-size="24" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e74c3c" font-weight="900">☠️</text>
    </svg>
    `;

    // 4. 폭발(Boom) 이펙트 SVG
    const SVG_EXPLOSION = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 110" width="100%" height="100%">
      <polygon points="50,15 63,38 90,32 75,54 95,75 68,78 68,102 48,85 28,100 32,76 8,72 26,52 12,32 38,36" fill="#e74c3c"/>
      <polygon points="50,28 59,44 78,40 68,55 82,70 63,72 63,88 50,76 36,86 39,69 22,67 34,54 24,40 42,43" fill="#f1c40f"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="18" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <text x="50" y="66" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c0392b" font-weight="bold">BOOM!</text>
    </svg>
    `;

    // Web Audio 사운드 시스템
    let audioCtx = null;
    function getSoundContext() {
      if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      }
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
      return audioCtx;
    }

    // 뿅망치 타격음
    function soundHit(multiplier) {
      try {
        const ctx = getSoundContext();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        
        // 망치 등급에 따른 피치와 묵직함 차이
        const startFreq = multiplier === 2 ? 800 : (multiplier === 1.5 ? 680 : 580);
        osc.type = multiplier === 2 ? 'square' : 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(startFreq, ctx.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, ctx.currentTime + 0.13);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.7, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.13);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.14);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 폭탄 폭발음 (노이즈 버스트 느낌)
    function soundBomb() {
      try {
        const ctx = getSoundContext();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.type = 'sawtooth';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, ctx.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(40, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.9, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.36);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 팝업 출현음
    function soundPop() {
      try {
        const ctx = getSoundContext();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(260, ctx.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(540, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.09);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // DOM 요소
    const cabinet = document.getElementById('arcade-cabinet');
    const timeEl = document.getElementById('txt-time');
    const scoreEl = document.getElementById('txt-score');
    const highEl = document.getElementById('txt-high');
    const comboEl = document.getElementById('txt-combo');
    const startBtn = document.getElementById('btn-start');
    const modal = document.getElementById('modal-over');
    const resultDesc = document.getElementById('txt-result');

    // 망치 배율 및 커서 관리
    let currentHammer = 'wood';
    let scoreMultiplier = 1.0;

    window.selectHammer = function(type) {
      currentHammer = type;
      document.querySelectorAll('.hammer-tab').forEach(t => {
        t.classList.toggle('selected', t.dataset.hammer === type);
      });
      cabinet.classList.remove('cursor-wood', 'cursor-iron', 'cursor-golden');
      cabinet.classList.add('cursor-' + type);

      if (type === 'wood') scoreMultiplier = 1.0;
      else if (type === 'iron') scoreMultiplier = 1.5;
      else if (type === 'golden') scoreMultiplier = 2.0;
    };

    // 슬롯 엔티티 초기화
    const slots = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const el = document.getElementById('slot-' + i);
      const data = {
        id: i,
        el: el,
        type: 'none', // 'mole', 'bomb', 'none'
        isHit: false,
        timer: null
      };

      el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        whack(data);
      });

      slots.push(data);
    }

    // 게임 상태
    let score = 0;
    let high = 0;
    let timeLeft = 30;
    let combo = 0;
    let isRunning = false;
    let gameClock = null;
    let spawnerTimer = null;
    let lastSlotId = -1;

    // 타격 처리
    function whack(s) {
      if (!isRunning || s.type === 'none' || s.isHit) return;
      s.isHit = true;

      if (s.type === 'mole') {
        soundHit(scoreMultiplier);
        combo++;
        comboEl.textContent = combo + (combo >= 4 ? ' 🔥' : '');

        // 점수 계산: 기본 10점 * 망치배율 + 콤보 보너스
        const added = Math.round((10 * scoreMultiplier) + Math.floor(combo / 2) * 5);
        score += added;
        scoreEl.textContent = score + '점';

        s.el.innerHTML = SVG_MOLE_HIT;

        // 팝업 이펙트
        const pop = document.createElement('div');
        pop.className = 'pop-score';
        pop.textContent = `+${added}${combo >= 3 ? ' COMBO!' : ''}`;
        s.el.parentElement.appendChild(pop);
        setTimeout(() => pop.remove(), 600);

        if (s.timer) clearTimeout(s.timer);
        s.timer = setTimeout(() => hideEntity(s), 230);

      } else if (s.type === 'bomb') {
        // 폭탄 격추 시 감점 및 화면 진동
        soundBomb();
        combo = 0;
        comboEl.textContent = '0';

        const penalty = 30;
        score = Math.max(0, score - penalty);
        scoreEl.textContent = score + '점';

        cabinet.classList.add('screen-shake');
        setTimeout(() => cabinet.classList.remove('screen-shake'), 360);

        s.el.innerHTML = SVG_EXPLOSION;

        const pop = document.createElement('div');
        pop.className = 'pop-score pop-bomb';
        pop.textContent = `💥 -${penalty}점 폭탄!`;
        s.el.parentElement.appendChild(pop);
        setTimeout(() => pop.remove(), 700);

        if (s.timer) clearTimeout(s.timer);
        s.timer = setTimeout(() => hideEntity(s), 300);
      }
    }

    function showEntity(s, kind) {
      s.type = kind;
      s.isHit = false;
      s.el.innerHTML = kind === 'mole' ? SVG_MOLE_NORMAL : SVG_BOMB;
      s.el.classList.add('peek');
      soundPop();

      // 난이도 상승 (남은 시간에 따라 머무는 시간 단축)
      const stayDuration = Math.max(450, 850 - (30 - timeLeft) * 14);

      s.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (s.type !== 'none' && !s.isHit) {
          hideEntity(s);
          // 두더지를 놓쳤을 때 콤보 리셋
          if (kind === 'mole') {
            combo = 0;
            comboEl.textContent = '0';
          }
        }
      }, stayDuration);
    }

    function hideEntity(s) {
      s.type = 'none';
      s.el.classList.remove('peek');
      if (s.timer) {
        clearTimeout(s.timer);
        s.timer = null;
      }
    }

    // 스폰 루프 (폭탄은 약 25% 확률로 섞여 나옴)
    function spawnLoop() {
      if (!isRunning) return;

      const available = slots.filter(s => s.type === 'none' && s.id !== lastSlotId);
      if (available.length > 0) {
        const picked = available[Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length)];
        lastSlotId = picked.id;

        // 25% 확률로 위험한 폭탄 등장
        const isBomb = Math.random() < 0.25;
        showEntity(picked, isBomb ? 'bomb' : 'mole');
      }

      const nextDelay = Math.max(360, 680 - (30 - timeLeft) * 11);
      spawnerTimer = setTimeout(spawnLoop, nextDelay);
    }

    window.startGame = function() {
      if (isRunning) return;
      getSoundContext();

      isRunning = true;
      score = 0;
      timeLeft = 30;
      combo = 0;
      scoreEl.textContent = '0점';
      timeEl.textContent = '30초';
      comboEl.textContent = '0';
      modal.style.display = 'none';

      startBtn.disabled = true;
      startBtn.style.opacity = '0.6';
      startBtn.textContent = '🎮 게임 진행 중...';

      slots.forEach(s => hideEntity(s));

      gameClock = setInterval(() => {
        timeLeft--;
        timeEl.textContent = timeLeft + '초';
        if (timeLeft <= 0) endGame();
      }, 1000);

      spawnLoop();
    };

    function endGame() {
      isRunning = false;
      clearInterval(gameClock);
      clearTimeout(spawnerTimer);
      slots.forEach(s => hideEntity(s));

      startBtn.disabled = false;
      startBtn.style.opacity = '1';
      startBtn.textContent = '🚀 게임 시작!';

      if (score > high) {
        high = score;
        highEl.textContent = high + '점 (최고!)';
      }

      resultDesc.innerHTML = `최종 점수: <b style="color:#27ae60; font-size:30px;">${score}점</b><br><small style="color:#7f8c8d; font-size:16px;">선택 망치: ${currentHammer.toUpperCase()} (x${scoreMultiplier})</small>`;
      modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    window.retryGame = function() {
      modal.style.display = 'none';
      startGame();
    };
  </script>
</body>
